added:
*Overhauled Scoring*
Scores are now based off of the *amount of tokens* in your expression. In other words, your scores is calculated from the number of functions, operators, and numbers used (_without regard for their individual lengths_).

*Streak System*
Track your daily wins and aim for the longest streak!
The flame will burn when you've achieved your win for the day. _Check it out in the top-left corner!_>You can toggle it on and off in Settings!>

*New Function 'summ'*: _the Sigma (capital) function_
Usage: summ(<start : end/>, <expression/>)
_ex: summ(0:10, 2 /* k) = 2/*0 + 2/*1 + ...  +2/*10.

*New Constants 0, 10, k*
_10 is so important that many of us have 10 fingers, and 0 is so important that many of us have 0 tails_.
'*k*' is a dummy variable for iterative functions (_ex: summ_)

*New Operation '~'*: Bitwise Negation
Now added for you nerds who want to do this bitwise (along with '&' and '|' that already exist)

*Dark Mode*: (available in Settings)
_Do your eyes hurt too much? Are they strained? Take a break? No, the work must continue..._
changed: Parentheses will now autocomplete themselves when you type (_Just like in VSCode..._).
Improved feedback will appear when an answer is not accepted.
Identical scores will be given the same ranking. Position from the top is first determined by time, then by name.
Autocorrect and Autocapitalize are now disabled for a better typing experience on mobile.
fixed: Leaderboard submissions would not go through with certain name lengths.
'What's Allowed' popup sometimes would have text offscreen.
Background would not correctly expand if leaderboard was large.
